Billing.tryAgain: Check your connection and try again.

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
subscriptions.description: Every tool your workspace pays for, what it costs and what happens next.
subscriptions.emptyBody: Tools you start or buy show up here.

summary.label: Summary
summary.monthlyHint: Paid tools only. Yearly plans count as a twelfth; trials aren't included.
summary.seatsHint: Active members who use a seat. Per-seat plans charge for each.
summary.unlocked: Follows your billing country until your first payment.

lines.manualRenewal: Manual: it ends unless you renew it
lines.priceChangeBody: You keep your current price until then. The new one applies from the next renewal.
lines.downgradeBody: Until then you keep everything in {plan}.
lines.trialHint: Choose a plan before the trial ends to keep using {tool} without a break.
lines.pastDueHint: The last renewal wasn't paid. Pay by {date} or {tool} becomes read-only for your team.
lines.readOnlyHint: Your team can view {tool} but not change anything until the renewal is paid.
lines.mandatoryHint: {tool} is the workspace itself, so it can't be cancelled.

done.cancelled: {tool} is cancelled. You keep it until {date}.

errors.paymentFailedPastDue: Nothing changed: {tool} keeps full access until {date}. Check the card or add another one, then try again.
errors.paymentFailedReadOnly: Nothing changed: {tool} is still read-only. Check the card or add another one, then try again.
errors.mandatory: {tool} can't be cancelled: it's the workspace itself.
errors.noCardBody: The renewal is charged to your default card, and none of your cards can be charged.
errors.changed: This subscription changed in the meantime
errors.changedBody: The page now shows where it stands. Check it and try again if you still need to.
errors.suspended: This workspace is suspended, so nothing can be changed. Contact support.

confirm.cancelImpact: Your team keeps {tool} on {plan} until {date}, and nothing more is charged. After that it stops. You can resume until then.
confirm.endTrialImpact: The trial ends at once and your team loses access to {tool}. Nothing is charged.
confirm.resumeImpact: {tool} renews on {date} at <amount></amount> {cycle}, charged to your default card.
confirm.downgradeImpact: The move happens on {date}, at the end of this period, with no refund for it. Until then you keep everything in {current}. From then it costs <amount></amount> {cycle}, and anything beyond {plan}'s limits stops working.
confirm.keepPlanImpact: The move to {lower} on {date} is called off. {tool} renews on {plan} at <amount></amount> {cycle}.
confirm.retryImpact: The unpaid renewal is charged to <card></card> now. If it goes through, {tool} is active again at once.
confirm.retryNoCard: The unpaid renewal is charged to your default card now.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: Every invoice for this workspace, newest first. Open one to see its lines, payments and refunds, or to print it.
invoices.emptyBody: Your first invoice appears here when a paid plan renews or is bought.

invoice.title: Invoice {number}
invoice.notFoundBody: It may belong to another workspace, or the link is wrong.

cards.title: Payment methods
cards.description: The cards your renewals are charged to. The default one is charged first.
cards.failed: Your payment methods couldn't be loaded
cards.defaultExpiredHint: Renewals can't be charged to an expired card. Add a new one and make it the default.
cards.expiredNoDefault: An expired card can't be the default. Add a new card instead.
cards.removeImpact: It's no longer charged for anything. You can add it again later.
cards.removeDefaultImpact: Renewals are charged to {next} from now on.
cards.removeLastImpact: {count, plural, one {Your renewal depends on this card. With no other working card, it can't be paid.} other {Your # renewals depend on this card. With no other working card, they can't be paid.}}
cards.lastMethodTitle: This card can't be removed yet
cards.lastMethodBody: {count, plural, =0 {It's your only working card and your renewals are charged to it. Add another card first, then remove this one.} one {It's your only working card and your paid subscription renews on it. Add another card first, then remove this one.} other {It's your only working card and your # paid subscriptions renew on it. Add another card first, then remove this one.}}
cards.noWorkingTitle: None of your cards can be charged
cards.noWorkingBody: Add a card that hasn't expired so your renewals go through.
cards.emptyBody: Add a card so paid plans can renew on their own.

add.title: Add a card
add.description: Renewals can be charged to it once it's added.
add.hostedTitle: Your card details go to the payment provider
add.hostedBody: In the live product you type the card into the payment provider's own secure form, and OrgTik never sees the full number. Here a test card stands in for it.
add.last4Help: Four digits, as printed on the card.
add.expiresInvalid: Enter the month and year as MM/YY, for example 08/28.
add.expired: This card has expired. Use one that's still valid.
add.makeDefaultHelp: Renewals are charged to the default card first.
add.failed: The card couldn't be added. Try again.
add.suspended: This workspace is suspended, so no card can be added. Contact support.

details.title: Billing details
details.description: Who your invoices are made out to and where they're sent. The country decides the tax.
details.failed: Your billing details couldn't be loaded
details.legalNameHelp: As registered: it's printed on every invoice.
details.emailHelp: Invoices and payment notices go here.
details.taxIdHelp: Printed on invoices when you have one.
details.countryHelp: It sets the tax and, until your first payment, the currency.
details.countryLockedHelp: Your currency ({currency}) is locked. A new country goes to support as a request to move your workspace.
details.moveBody: Saving sends support a request to move your billing. Until they do, nothing changes: you're billed as now, in {currency}.
details.emailInvalid: Enter an email address, like name@company.com.
details.countryInvalid: Choose a country from the list.
details.savedCurrency: Billing details saved. Prices are now in {currency}.
details.saveFailed: Your details couldn't be saved. Try again.
details.suspended: This workspace is suspended, so nothing can be changed. Contact support.
details.queuedTitle: Your move to {country} is with support
details.queuedBody: They'll check it and move your workspace's billing, usually at the next renewal, and write to {email} when it's done. Until then you're billed from {from} in {currency}, and your other changes are saved.
details.taxBody: Added to every invoice for a business in {country}.
details.reverseCharge: For businesses with a valid tax ID it's reverse-charged.
details.noTax: No tax is added to invoices in {country}.
details.currencyLocked: Locked since your first payment. Prices and invoices stay in it.
details.currencyOpen: It follows your country until your first payment, then it's locked.
